scope: Exploratory: same filtered population as results/sufficiency, whose test split is already inspected.
primary: cat_style vs per-query mean of shuffled arms
null: Curveball trades on training bundles: item frequencies and bundle sizes kept, co-occurrence destroyed. Only cat is rebuilt from them, including its slot penalty; hist stays real.

decision.raw_description: Supported on a dataset if cat_style beats content on NDCG with Holm p<.05.
decision.shuffled_history: Supported on a dataset if cat_style beats the shuffled mean on NDCG with Holm p<.05 and beats every seed. If not, the gain does not depend on real bundle lift and the claim fails there.
decision.spotify: Not tested: its selected recipes do not use cat, so these controls cannot speak to it.

note: style uses title features only, while content joins title, image and description, so the primary raw-description arm has more input. allstyle_cat and title are the same-input secondary arms.
